title: Gmsh Reference Manual
version_or_date: Rolling stable manual; archive before selecting a pinned runtime
locators: Section 1.2 Mesh module
Section 1.2.3 Elementary entities vs physical groups
Tutorial t1; x1 Geometry and mesh data
supported_claims: Physical groups associate boundary/volume entities with solver-relevant identities; default export can omit elements outside physical groups.
limits: Meshing capability does not verify geometry, stable identities after CAD edits, solver-import compatibility or physical convergence.

title: Elmer Models Manual
version_or_date: Rolling documentation snapshot; retrieved file 364 PDF pages
locators: Chapter 1 Heat Equation; section 1.2.5 Boundary Conditions
Printed pages 14-16: view-factor shadowing, geometry updates, Gebhart and radiosity settings
supported_claims: Elmer documents thermal radiation, Gebhart and radiosity approaches, ray-based shadowing controls and optional caching/update thresholds.
limits: Settings that drop factors, freeze geometry or emissivities are numerical approximations requiring convergence checks. The documented spectral model is not evidence that arbitrary wafer optical transmission is handled.

title: Molflow 2.6 algorithm
locators: Section 1 Introduction, printed p2
Sections 2 Steady-state simulation and 4 evaluation/textures
supported_claims: Test-particle Monte Carlo omits intermolecular collisions, tracks facet hits and scales test-particle tallies to physical quantities; independent histories permit parallel sampling.
limits: Algorithm reference is historical, not a release-specific guarantee. A Molflow-reported wall-flight mean path is not the gas-gas collision mean free path. Beam angular/energy normalization and current automation must be demonstrated.

title: SPARTA manual: Accelerating SPARTA performance
locators: Sections 5.1 Measuring performance, 5.2 Packages with optimized styles, 5.3 KOKKOS package
supported_claims: Kokkos provides acceleration for supported styles on CPUs/GPUs; speedup depends on problem and commands; roundoff, precision and random-number differences can affect results.
limits: An RTX GPU alone is not a performance guarantee. Benchmark the pinned build, active physics styles and statistics.

title: COMSOL 6.4: The Molecular Flow Module Physics Interface Guide
locators: Rarefied Flow: free molecular and transitional interface discussion
supported_claims: The free molecular interface targets Kn > 10 and uses angular coefficients; re-emission directions independent of incidence are an assumed boundary condition. Transitional flow is more computationally demanding.
limits: A regime label is not a quantitative bound on neglected collisions or directional deposition error. Directional/specular beam cases require capability demonstrations.

title: The Plasma Module User's Guide
locators: Printed p194 (PDF page 194): Inductively Coupled Plasma interface and AC/DC requirement for 3D
Printed p223: Validity of Fluid Models (CCP discussion)
Printed pp231-234: Theory for Inductively Coupled Plasmas
supported_claims: The ICP interface treats induction in the frequency domain and couples plasma variables. The interface-specific section states 3D ICP requires AC/DC Module; microwave plasma uses RF Module. The manual discusses fluid-model validity limits.
limits: Do not apply the CCP rough pressure threshold directly to the actual MBE ICP source. Determine charged-particle nonlocality, chemistry and source dimensions. Licensing should be checked for chosen dimensions/features.

title: Reduced-Basis Approximations and A Posteriori Error Bounds for Nonaffine and Nonlinear Partial Differential Equations: Application to Inverse Analysis
version_or_date: PhD thesis, June 2005 (PDF title page; landing page lists September)
locators: Sections 3.2.4 Offline-Online Computational Procedure and 3.3 A Posteriori Error Estimation
Sections 3.5.3-3.5.4 and 10.2 future directions/limitations
supported_claims: Reduced-basis evaluation separates offline construction and online prediction, with residual/stability-based error bounds in specified problem classes.
limits: Rigorous bounds require their assumptions; nonlinear/nonaffine generalizations can include non-rigorous components. Bounds relative to discretized equations do not validate physical model form.

title: Examining Spatial (Grid) Convergence
locators: Asymptotic Range of Convergence
Richardson Extrapolation
Grid Convergence Index (GCI)
supported_claims: A three-grid study supports observed-order and asymptotic-range checks; grid-convergence uncertainty is distinct from physical accuracy.
limits: CFD tutorial methodology must be adapted to FEM, particle statistics, coupled solvers and nonsmooth observables. A tiny two-grid change is insufficient evidence of convergence.

title: SPARTA Features
locators: Models
Gas-phase collisions and chemistry
Surface collisions and chemistry

supported_claims: SPARTA supports low-density-gas DSMC, local grids, VSS/VHS/HS collision models, surface interactions, restart files and an ambipolar plasma approximation.
limits: A listed ambipolar approximation is not a self-consistent RF ICP or general sheath model. Ga/N/Al collision and reaction parameters still need evidence.
